name: Unidirectional semiconductor power switch
summary: A unidirectional semiconductor switch has a specified direction for its power conduction or control behaviour.
description: A unidirectional semiconductor switch has a specified direction for its power conduction or control behaviour. The functional direction must be identified so reversing a schematic orientation does not reverse the intended meaning.
readingNotes: Use terminal polarity and the product circuit rather than page orientation to determine direction.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Unidirectional operation concerns the circuit path; it does not describe the direction of all system power flows.
